LanguageData.LP_SecondWind.label: second wind
LanguageData.LP_SecondWind.description: The fighter steadies their breath, continuously healing injuries over 600 ticks (total = 20 × martial power, bleeding wounds first).
LanguageData.LP_Shaken.label: shaken
LanguageData.LP_Shaken.description: Shaken: movement ×0.7, lower melee hit chance and shooting accuracy.
LanguageData.LP_ActionSurge.label: action surge
LanguageData.LP_WeaponMastery.label: weapon specialization
LanguageData.LP_WeaponMastery.description: Melee damage increased (×1.24 to ×1.45, tiered by martial power); ranged weapon damage also uses the same tier multiplier.
LanguageData.LP_WeaponMastery.stages.0.label: proficient
LanguageData.LP_WeaponMastery.stages.1.label: adept
LanguageData.LP_WeaponMastery.stages.2.label: specialist
LanguageData.LP_WeaponMastery.stages.3.label: master
LanguageData.LP_WeaponMastery.stages.4.label: grandmaster
LanguageData.LP_Indomitable.label: indomitable
LanguageData.LP_Indomitable.description: Feels no pain, cannot be downed by pain, immune to stuns, mental break threshold -15%.
LanguageData.LP_GuardStance.label: guardian stance
LanguageData.LP_GuardStance.description: Armor increased (+16% to +30%, tiered by martial power), movement ×0.7; 30% of damage taken by allies within radius 3 is transferred to yourself.
LanguageData.LP_SurgeOfBattle.label: renewed fighting spirit
LanguageData.LP_SurgeOfBattle.description: Melee cooldown ×0.5, melee damage ×1.5, immune to stuns; every melee kill instantly resets all fighter maneuvers.
LanguageData.LP_WhirlwindFury.label: whirlwind momentum
LanguageData.LP_WhirlwindFury.description: This Whirlwind Attack's melee damage × martial power.
LanguageData.LP_ChargeStrike.label: charge momentum
LanguageData.LP_ChargeStrike.description: The melee hit on landing from a charge deals ×(1 + 0.3 × martial power) damage.
LanguageData.LP_ExtraAttack.label: extra attack
LanguageData.LP_ExtraAttack.description: Extra Attack of martial classes: shorter melee and shooting cooldowns, and a chance of a follow-up after a normal melee hit. Tiers: any martial class at level 5 gives tier 1, fighter level 10 tier 2, level 15 tier 3.
LanguageData.LP_ExtraAttack.stages._1.label: tier 1
LanguageData.LP_ExtraAttack.stages._2.label: tier 2
LanguageData.LP_ExtraAttack.stages._3.label: tier 3
LanguageData.LP_SteadyAim.label: steady aim
LanguageData.LP_SteadyAim.description: Hunkered down to aim: shooting warmup ×0.5, ranged hit ×1.15, movement ×0.5.
LanguageData.LP_Suppressed.label: suppressed
LanguageData.LP_Suppressed.description: Pinned down by suppressing fire: movement ×0.6, ranged hit ×0.75.
LanguageData.LP_RapidFire.label: rapid shot
LanguageData.LP_RapidFire.description: Shooting cooldown ×0.5; burst weapons fire 1 extra shot per burst.
LanguageData.LP_DeadEye.label: eye of death
LanguageData.LP_DeadEye.description: Ranged attacks always hit and ignore cover, shooting damage ×1.5; every enemy shot dead instantly resets all fighter maneuvers.
LanguageData.LP_Hobbled.label: shot in the leg
LanguageData.LP_Hobbled.description: Leg hit by a precise shot: movement ×0.5.
LanguageData.LP_SuppressingVolley.label: laying down suppressing fire
LanguageData.LP_MonkStance.label: martial arts
LanguageData.LP_MonkStance.description: Unarmed monk: melee damage increased (× 1 + 0.5 × martial power), melee cooldown ×0.85.
LanguageData.LP_MonkUnarmored.label: unarmored grace
LanguageData.LP_MonkUnarmored.description: Monk without heavy armor: melee dodge +10% × martial power.
LanguageData.LP_Deflecting.label: deflect missiles
LanguageData.LP_Deflecting.description: Each ranged attack's damage is reduced (severity = reduction); reduced to 0, the whole shot is deflected.
LanguageData.LP_StepOfTheWind.label: step of the wind
LanguageData.LP_StepOfTheWind.description: Light as the wind: movement ×1.6, melee dodge +20%.
LanguageData.LP_DiamondSoul.label: diamond body
LanguageData.LP_DiamondSoul.description: Ki fills the whole body: damage taken ×0.7, immune to stuns, mental break threshold -10%.
LanguageData.LP_QuiveringPalm.label: quivering
LanguageData.LP_QuiveringPalm.description: A monk's quivering ki has been planted in the body and will burst in a few seconds.
LanguageData.LP_EmptyBody.label: empty body
LanguageData.LP_EmptyBody.description: Body dissolved into the void: invisible, damage taken ×0.5, heals every second (severity = healing per second).
LanguageData.LP_SmiteReady.label: divine smite
LanguageData.LP_SmiteReady.description: The next melee hit adds holy damage (severity = damage), valid for 10 seconds.
LanguageData.LP_SacredWeapon.label: sacred weapon
LanguageData.LP_SacredWeapon.description: Every melee hit adds holy damage (severity = damage).
LanguageData.LP_Enmity.label: vow of enmity
LanguageData.LP_Enmity.description: Sworn against by a paladin: that paladin deals more damage to it.
LanguageData.LP_ProtectionAura.label: aura of protection
LanguageData.LP_ProtectionAura.description: In a paladin's Aura of Protection: damage taken reduced (×0.8 to ×0.95, by divine power), mental break threshold -5%.
LanguageData.LP_CourageAura.label: aura of courage
LanguageData.LP_CourageAura.description: In a paladin's Aura of Courage: does not panic and flee.
LanguageData.LP_Sheltered.label: protected
LanguageData.LP_Sheltered.description: A paladin stands in front: damage taken ×0.5.
LanguageData.LP_HolyAvatar.label: holy avatar
LanguageData.LP_HolyAvatar.description: Clad in holy light: burns surrounding enemies and heals surrounding allies every second (severity = damage per second), immune to stuns and panic.
